title: cirsium iowense
intro: Cirsium iowense, commonly known as Iowa thistle, is a species of thistle native to the Midwestern United States. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium iowense are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. Bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
